targets.note: both legs read the merge archive: header shape and the section-33 migration cross-references.
conflict-marker scan runs over every tracked text file, so its surface is the text tree.
semgrep scans every source surface plus the workflow YAML; the drift leg re-checks the ruleset against it.

structural hygiene and the empty-directory guard are properties of the TREE, not of any file, so the surface is the whole tree. This is the widest declared target and it is deliberate: these legs must run on any change that adds or removes a path.
actionlint over the workflow files themselves.
yamllint + kubeconform + the cluster-tree consumer roster; the surface is every YAML in the tree.
